reviews.eventQuote: the bill was 72.6 JOD each
reviews.note: No movement is asserted, but the standalone cost fragment could be personal discussion or a bill/price fragment. Do not infer the governing context from its legacy source label; hold context review.

reviews.contextQuote: دفعت الحساب للمطعم ولا ادفع انا؟
reviews.eventQuote: دفعت الحساب للمطعم ولا ادفع انا؟
reviews.note: The speaker asks whether the other person paid; the event outcome is not asserted.

reviews.eventQuote: تم إيداع مبلغ 46.25 JOD نقداً في محفظة زين كاش الخاصة بك عبر صراف آلي.
reviews.note: Account-style cash deposit notice reports a completed deposit. Bank/wallet identity is not classification evidence.

reviews.eventQuote: اشحن خطك الخلوي بقيمة 9 دنانير أو أكثر عبر تطبيق المحفظة
reviews.note: A promotional top-up directive with a conditional bonus, without an asserted top-up outcome or posted bonus.

reviews.eventQuote: تم دفع فاتورة شركة أمنية للهواتف بنجاح بقيمة 43.766 JOD من خلال خدمة إي فواتيركم.
reviews.note: The bill is stated to have been paid successfully; the subsequent balance is separate context.

reviews.eventQuote: Internal movement completed: JOD 77 from your current account to your own savings account.
reviews.note: Completed own-account movement, still excluded under recording policy. These fields do not reopen that decision.

reviews.eventQuote: Merchant wallet payment settled
reviews.note: Settled merchant debit reported against the wallet.

reviews.eventQuote: أُودع استرداد نقدي بقيمة ٢٫٤٥ JOD في حسابك
reviews.note: Credited cash reward, not an uncredited entitlement or points.

reviews.contextQuote: its debit was posted to the wallet.
reviews.eventQuote: Your bill payment completed and its debit was posted to the wallet.
reviews.note: Missing amount does not negate reported completion; logging can still require review.

reviews.eventQuote: أُضيف رد دفعة ملغاة بقيمة ۲۹ دينار إلى حسابك كحركة دائنة.
reviews.note: The selected event is the completed refund, not the cancelled purchase it refunds.

reviews.eventQuote: The request was rejected and nothing was debited.
reviews.note: A refused withdrawal notice can be a financial notice without a completed event.

reviews.eventQuote: JOD 13 was debited from your account for a completed purchase.
reviews.note: The sentence reports an account debit; the prefix describes its textual frame, not authenticated provenance.

reviews.eventQuote: سددت فاتورة الكهرباء من حسابك وتم الخصم بنجاح.
reviews.note: The account debit is explicitly stated. This is not merely an unpaid bill notice.

reviews.contextQuote: See the statement for the withdrawal amount.
reviews.eventQuote: Cash was dispensed and the withdrawal debit was posted to your account.
reviews.note: Dispensed cash and a posted debit are explicit despite the absent numeric amount.

reviews.contextQuote: in your account and the credit was posted.
reviews.eventQuote: A personal transfer arrived in your account and the credit was posted.
reviews.note: Personal describes the transfer, not an interpersonal claim; account-credit wording governs this authored message.

reviews.contextQuote: View your statement for the amount.
reviews.eventQuote: The wallet debit was successfully posted after bill payment completed.
reviews.note: The trailing instruction is subordinate to an independently asserted account posting.

reviews.eventQuote: Your purchase refund of JOD 9.75 was credited successfully.
reviews.note: The refund is explicitly credited and complete.

reviews.eventQuote: I sent my rent share
reviews.note: A friend claims a completed transfer; that described completion does not make this a bank/wallet receipt.

reviews.eventQuote: The booking amount was booked as a settled debit on your card.
reviews.note: The debit is explicitly settled, not merely an authorization hold.

reviews.eventQuote: فشل قبل إخراج المال وألغي دون خصم.
reviews.note: The payout failed before cash delivery; no debit occurred.

reviews.eventQuote: استقبل الحساب تعويض أجرة الرحلة من مشارك آخر وأصبح المبلغ متاحاً.
reviews.note: An account receipt and available funds are reported; transfer ownership remains a separate policy field.

reviews.eventQuote: سويت الفاتورة وسجل اقتطاع قيمتها من المحفظة.
reviews.note: The settlement and wallet deduction are explicit.

reviews.eventQuote: لم تسجل دفعة المشتريات ولم يقتطع رصيد.
reviews.note: The payment was cancelled before execution, with no booked payment or deduction.
